text:
sam_sales: Heads-up - FinRegCorp POC blocked. Trying to provision Dedicated GPU pool in ap-southeast1, fails. They need GPUs for demo tomorrow. Anyone?

maria_se: Paste error output and reservation id. Reserved or on-demand?

sam_sales: Reserved monthly commit 2x A100-80GB. CLI output: ERROR: 409 Conflict: reservation config incompatible with region. Caused by: Region 'ap-southeast1' not in reservation.allowed_regions. Retrying... ERROR: 429 Rate limit exceeded (provisioning-api).

leo_infra: We don't support reservation-bound Dedicated pools in ap-southeast1 yet (feature gated). Options: change to ap-southeast2, or on-demand in ap-southeast1.

csm_jordan: Customer requires data residency in ap-southeast1. Need exception or fast fix. Also they want pricing delta (committed vs on-demand) for 2 A100s ~3 weeks.

tara_engineer: On-demand possible if quota exists. Need manual approval for cost. @ops_murphy check quota and speed approval.

ops_murphy: Available A100s in ap-southeast1 = 0. Quota bump 4-6h. Immediate choices: route to eu-west1, mix regions (not ideal), or emergency enable reservations in ap-southeast1.

sam_sales: Timeline tight. Mixed regions risk failing acceptance due to latency.

maria_se: Security questionnaire requires residency in ap-southeast1. Can't run eu-west1 without legal signoff. Escalate.

leo_infra: Can fast-track region support for reservations for this account but needs emergency deploy and rollback plan. ETA ~6h if deprioritized.

eng_platform_lead: OK to approve emergency change when back, need rollback plan and risk blurb. @leo_infra coordinate with @tara_engineer and @ops_murphy.

oncall-bot: Deploy job #4821 triggered by leo_infra: applying reservation policy patch.

ops_murphy: Note earlier 429s show automation retried without exponential backoff. Filing follow-up to add backoff. Don't hammer provisioning during fix.

maria_se: Filed ENGOPS-3342 to add backoff and better retry logging. Updated POC runbook with reservation/region checklist.

leo_infra: Deploy in progress. Migrating to add ap-southeast1 to allowed_regions for reservation policies. ETA 30-45min for deploy + verification.

oncall-bot: Deploy job #4821 logs: applying policy patch, reloading config, warming reservation cache, health checks passing.

leo_infra: Provisioning retried and succeeded. Pool id pool-finreg-77. 2x A100-80GB online in ap-southeast1. Verified with smoke test.

csm_jordan: Customer confirmed and demo is GO. Got signed security addendum for residency. Thanks :thumbsup: 

sam_sales: Thanks team. I'll DM pricing comparison (committed vs on-demand) for the 3-week POC and confirm discount.

ops_murphy: Follow-ups: ENGOPS-3342 (retry/backoff), INFRA-6741 (region reservation support doc), cost center approval noted.

maria_se: Closing loop in POC checklist and adding guidance about region gating on reservations.

sam_sales: Closing thread. Will ping for additional compliance artifacts. Great job everyone.
